questions.subject: BUSINESS_ENTREPRENEURSHIP
questions.stem: At Dahliamarsh, a supervisor directly oversees workers making bike accessories and reports to a middle manager. What level of management is the supervisor?

options.text: Top management, which sets overall strategy
options.misconception: Top managers do not directly supervise production workers

options.text: Strategic management, which handles long-term direction
options.misconception: Confuses a supervisory role with corporate strategy

options.text: First-line management, which supervises non-managerial employees
Middle management, which implements departmental plans
options.misconception: The supervisor is below middle management

questions.explanation: First-line managers, often called supervisors, directly coordinate the work of non-managerial employees. Middle managers implement plans through those supervisors, and top managers set broad organizational direction.
questions.hint: Directly overseeing workers indicates the lowest management level.
